products.name: Cognigy
products.note: Conversational AI platform for customer service; GDPR-compliant; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Cognigy is an enterprise software company focused on AI-driven customer service, operating under the name NiCE Cognigy. According to its own site, the company describes itself as powering enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat channels, with an emphasis on fast and personalized service delivery in contact center environments.

The company's primary product is a conversational AI platform designed for enterprise customer service use. The platform is noted as GDPR-compliant with EU-hosted options available, positioning it for organizations with data residency requirements. The site indicates the platform can be deployed in contact centers and offers both demo and free trial access.
